in_hindi.name: अतुल्या

in_tamil.name: அதுல்யா

in_telugu.name: అతుల్యా

in_marathi.name: Atulya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atulya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘atulya’ which means ‘rare’, ‘incomparable’, or ‘unique’. In Hindu mythology, Atulya is a name given to the divine goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswati, symbolizing their unique and incomparable attributes.
